name: Shakshuka
description: Eggs poached in spiced tomato sauce.

recipeInstructions.text: Heat olive oil in a large skillet over medium. Sauté onion and red bell pepper until softened, 5 minutes.
Add garlic and cook until fragrant, 1 minute.
Stir in cumin, paprika, and red pepper flakes. Let the spices bloom, 30 seconds.
Pour in crushed tomatoes, season with salt and black pepper, and simmer until the sauce thickens slightly, 12 minutes.
A pinch of sugar can balance the acidity. A spoonful of harissa adds depth.
Make small wells in the sauce and crack eggs into them. Cover, reduce heat to medium-low, and cook until the whites are set but the yolks are still runny, 7 minutes.
Top with feta cheese and cilantro. Serve straight from the skillet with crusty bread or pita for dipping.
